title: Chicken Orzo Bake With Creamy Boursin
description:
This Creamy Boursin Chicken Orzo Bake (from Andrea!) is an easy one-pan dinner that’s packed with tender
chicken, creamy Boursin cheese, plenty of juicy cherry tomatoes, zucchini, and perfectly cooked orzo.
Everything bakes together, making this dish very appealing in its combination of indulgence and ease. The
real star here is the creamy garlic-and-herb Boursin cheese melted into the orzo with all those tomatoes. You
could also roast some chicken thighs separately and serve with the pasta.
ingredients: 4 or so cups (or big handfuls) cherry tomatoes
½ cup or so grated Parmesan
Handful of fresh basil, roughly torn or chiffonaded
Sprinkle of fresh or dried oregano
directions: Place the Boursin cheese in the middle of a baking tray or ovenproof dish. Add the cherry tomatoes
Season with the chili flakes, oregano, salt and pepper, then give everything a couple of generous
Meanwhile, cook the orzo according to the packet instructions.
Remove the tray from the oven and stir and mash everything together until the Boursin creates a
creamy sauce. Add the cooked orzo, basil, and rotisserie chicken, then mix well.
Top generously with the grated Parmesan and return to the oven and broil carefully for several
minutes, until the cheese has melted and browned.
